_note: What this product is CALLED and where its panes sit. Every value here is the default the platform starts from; a package may change any of them.
_strings: Captions, by id. 'app.brand' is the wordmark in the top bar; nav.<view> names a tab; pane.<pane> a pane.
_panes: Pane ids: InspectionImage, DefectList, DefectSummary, Logging, ModelManager, ClientList, DashboardToolbar, TeachingToolbar, OptionToolbar. ClientList is the SERVER's list of its attached inspection clients; it never appears on a machine running as a client, whatever this file says.
_showOn: Which tabs the pane appears on. ["*"] means every tab.
_sizes: widthPct / heightPct are percentages of the frame; width / height are pixels. 'below' stacks a pane under another on the same dock bar.
_layoutClient: Overrides applied on a machine whose role is client. Only the keys stated change.
